title: CyclOT: Learning Quadratic Optimal Transport Maps via Synchronized Forward-Backward Interpolants
summary: We study the recovery of forward and reverse quadratic optimal-transport maps from unpaired samples in high dimensions. We introduce a bidirectional neural framework in which the learned maps induce forward and backward displacement interpolants, while the training objective combines bidirectional quadratic action, discriminator-restricted Jensen-Shannon endpoint objectives, and two-sided cycle consistency.
